name: ffx-esports
description: FFX ESPORTS premium battle royale tournament SaaS platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,socket,web,admin -c blue,magenta,blue,yellow "npm run dev -w @ffx/api" "npm run dev -w @ffx/socket-server" "npm run dev -w @ffx/web" "npm run dev -w @ffx/admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @ffx/types && npm run build -w @/utils && npm run build -w @/ui && npm run build -w @ffx/api && npm run build -w @ffx/socket-server && npm run build -w @ffx/web && npm run build -w @ffx/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ffx/types && npm run typecheck -w @/utils && npm run typecheck -w @/ui && npm run typecheck -w @ffx/api && npm run typecheck -w @ffx/socket-server && npm run typecheck -w @ffx/web && npm run typecheck -w @ffx/admin
